reconstructed.authorization: User: Restore documented behavior, mark reconstructed details.
reconstructed.pot_pool: Six normal stat pots follow generic Global Vault guide revision252183; monthly guides only say Random Pot. Normal-tier selection is a period/generic-guide inference. Burst and King battle pots are excluded.
reconstructed.pot_weights: Six equal weights1, not recovered historical probabilities.
reconstructed.color_weights: Eight equal weights1, independent with-replacement selections, not recovered historical probabilities.
reconstructed.formation: One normal stat pot in wave1, King Gil Snapper plus King Metal Minituar in wave2. Stage-owned actor/group IDs and positions are authored.
reconstructed.item_ownership: One Megacite plus one Tin on EACH wave2 enemy is inferred ownership preserving documented totals. Inherited KGS rare Tin is cleared, preventing a third Tin.
reconstructed.gil_projection: Original Global mission base200000 is allocated to final KGS nativegil4 =>200004, KMM20, pot0. Native per-enemy reward path preserves Gil boosts, battle failure and settlement behavior; original client ignores mission7UR4J2SE.
reconstructed.unit_exp_projection: Pot receives inferred+10unitEXP: native40 becomes50; KGS50+KMM40 =>documented140. Other combat profile fields are preserved source values.
reconstructed.profile_fidelity: Preserved Japanese same-species native profiles with exact Global capture/item identities, not recovered historical Global battle responses.
reconstructed.date_limit: Equivalent reward fingerprints can match several guide dates. All matching rows agree; exact date is not invented.
